name: spring-toast-stack
title: Spring Toast Stack
description: A cascade of alert cards stacked behind one another that eject smoothly when dismissed using hookean spring dynamics.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Minimal
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Compact
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Expressive
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Accent Only

## Rules

- Dismiss Eject Card: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
